snippet.title: Oppidum | Official Teaser Trailer | Coming Q1 2025
snippet.description:
Face the challenges of Oppidum, a survival adventure for 1-4 players with a unique story waiting to be unraveled. Build a camp, collect everything a fantastic land can offer, and use it to push forward through the island.
A world hanging by a thread needs your help – will you answer the call?

Coming to #Steam #Switch #PS4 #PS5 #xboxone #xboxseriesx #xboxseriess Q1 2025
